summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report covers sustainability performance for the 12 months ended December 31, 2025, highlighting progress in the shift to electric arc furnace steelmaking and decarbonization. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation event is disclosed. This is a routine disclosure of a sustainability report, not a special situation filing.
